phrases.textKn: Actually ಆ class ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮಗು ಇದ್ಲು, very shy, ಏನೂ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಿರ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ.
phrases.textEn: Actually, in that class there was a girl, very shy, who would not say anything.

phrases.textKn: ಆ ಮಗುವಿನ ತಾಯಿ ಒಂದಿನ school ಗೆ ಬಂದ್ರು, ಅವರ ಹೆಸರು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಡ, she was very supportive.
phrases.textEn: The child's mother came to school one day, her name is not given here, she was very supportive.

phrases.textKn: ನಾವು Nali Kali kit ಇಂದ phonics cards use ಮಾಡಿದ್ವಿ, ಆ girl ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾತಾಡೋಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ಲು.
phrases.textEn: We used phonics cards from the Nali Kali kit, and the girl slowly started to speak.
